Definition
[Green's function for the half-space]

↗ def:greens-function ↗ def:fundamental-solution-laplace ↗ def:reflection-half-space 1. ch2:2.2.4-def-3\group Green’s Functions

Green's function for $\R ^n_+$ is \[ G(x,y):=\Phi (y-x)-\Phi (y-\overline x) \qquad (x,y\in \R ^n_+,\ x e y). \] It vanishes when $y\in \partial \R ^n_+$.

On $y\in \partial \R ^n_+$, \[ rac{\partial G}{\partial u }(x,y) =- rac{2x_n}{n\alpha (n)|x-y|^n}, \] so the Poisson kernel is \[ K(x,y)= rac{2x_n}{n\alpha (n)|x-y|^n}. \]
